title: Retrospective monocentric study on CT-guided percutaneous cryoablation of malignant lung tumors
summary: Cryoablation is a minimally invasive method with which tumors can be treated by freezing. This study examines patients with malignant lung tumors or pulmonary metastases treated with CT-guided cryoablation. The aim is to evaluate local tumor control, treatment-related complications, and patient outcomes. Therefore existing clinical data and imaging are analyzed retrospectively.
conditions: Malignant lung tumors and pulmonary metastases

interventions.name: Patients with malignant lung tumors treated with CT-guided percutaneous cryoablation between 2012 and 2025 at the Johanna-Etienne Hospital in Neuss.
